details.method: For portable Git test fixtures, create the actual file/directory symlink and skip only explicit unsupported errors or Windows privilege 1314; propagate unrelated failures. Compute and consume relative paths after changing cwd to the fixture volume, restoring cwd in finally.
details.when: Windows runner cwd and temporary fixtures differ in volume, or host cannot create symlinks. Keep security assertions intact and separately run them on a capable host.
details.counterexample: An errno EACCES without Windows 1314, EPERM, missing target, existing link, or I/O error is not proof of unsupported symlinks. Windows capability skip cannot establish Linux or Windows security assertions.
details.trial_plan: On a future independent fixture task, run actual cross-volume Windows entry plus capable Linux symlink assertions; inject unrelated errors and require original failures, while known capability errors skip. Bind every receipt to exact source hashes.
